result.description: Frontend cloud platform for deploying and hosting web apps, with projects, deployments, domains, env vars, edge config, and storage managed via API.
result.auth_detail: Access token (personal/team-scoped) sent as Authorization: Bearer for direct use. OAuth2 via Sign in with Vercel / Integrations (client ID + secret from dashboard) gives 1h bearer access token plus 30-day rotating refresh token.
result.access_detail: Anyone with a Vercel account can create an access token in the dashboard and register an OAuth app/integration from the dashboard. Docs do not state any plan restriction for REST API; not confirmed whether Hobby can use every endpoint. Some endpoints (teams, Enterprise features) are plan-dependent.
result.api_notes: Public REST API at api.vercel.com covering deployments, projects, domains, DNS, env vars, teams, edge config, logs, firewall, auth tokens, etc. Official TypeScript SDK @vercel/sdk. Endpoint count not counted precisely, but surface is wide.

evidence.quote: Confirm that `VERCEL_TOKEN` is set and the header uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Vercel's IdP uses the OAuth 2.0 authorization framework, a widely adopted industry standard for securing and delegating access to resources on behalf of users.
For users to be able to use Sign in with Vercel in your application, they must have a Vercel account.
Use a Vercel access token to call the Vercel REST API with `curl`, then make the same request with `@vercel/sdk`.
